angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,008,765 km at 264.47 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 3.7812 +/- 0.0156 mas (same row, RUWE 1.00): 264.47 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.45 +/- 0.09 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of XO-4 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 1,008,765 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.1 +/- 0.22 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of XO-4 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6397 +/- 70 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of XO-4 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of XO-4 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/xo-4.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.157, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of XO-4 (pscomppars): spectral type F5 V, from McCullough et al. 2008 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2008arXiv0805.2921M/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, XO-4: main object type Em*, Emission-line Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of XO-4 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.04 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of XO-4 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.53558, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of XO-4 (pscomppars): age 2.1 Gyr, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of XO-4 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 8.8 km/s, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
